author: Ari Koslow
title: Eduardo Rivera penciled in to start Game 2 for Boston Friday
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Eduardo Rivera is penciled in to start Game 2 of Friday's doubleheader against the Rays.
impact: Rivera has tossed seven scoreless innings across two appearances this season. He is unlikely to be on a long leash.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Lux (shoulder) back in St. Pete with rehab assignment paused
desc: Gavin Lux is back in St. Pete with his rehab assignment paused.
impact: Lux recieved an injection in his right shoulder. He remains without a clear timetable to return to his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Fraley (hernia) back in St. Pete with rehab assignment paused
desc: Jake Fraley is back in St. Pete with his rehab assignment paused.
impact: Fraley is dealing with discomfort in his groin area. He remains without a clear timetable to return to his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roman Anthony (finger) making slow progress
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Roman Anthony continues to make slow progress.
impact: Anthony was scheduled to visit a specialist earlier in July. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcelo Mayer (forearm) to undergo X-rays early next week
desc: Marcelo Mayer is scheduled to undergo X-rays early next week.
impact: Mayer will undergo an X-ray to track his progress. There should be an update on his status later next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isiah Kiner-Falefa (forearm) to undergo X-rays early next week
desc: Isiah Kiner-Falefa is scheduled to undergo X-rays early next week.
impact: Kiner-Falefa will undergo an X-ray to track his progress. There should be an update on his status later next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ranger Suarez (groin) could be activated Tuesday
desc: Ranger Suarez could be activated from the injured list as early as Tuesday.
impact: Suarez threw over the All-Star break and is scheduled to throw again on Friday. He is eligible to be activated as early as Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early (elbow) throws over All-Star break
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Connelly Early threw over the All-Star break.
impact: Early is on the injured list with posterior elbow inflammation. The next step in his recovery will be returning to the mound.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Story (hernia) ramping up baseball activities
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Trevor Story is hitting and ramping up fielding activity.
impact: Story remains on the injured list with a hernia injury. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: Aaron Bummer opts out of contract with Cubs
desc: Aaron Bummer has opted out of his minor-league deal with the Cubs.
impact: Bummer signed with the Cubs at the beginning of June following his release from the Braves. The veteran southpaw will now hit the free-agent market again. Bummer was a serviceable reliever for the Braves in 2024 and 2025, but he has really struggled with consistency this year.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) moving rehab to Triple-A on Friday
desc: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) will have his rehab assignment moved up to Triple-A Gwinnett on Friday.
impact: Kim has been playing in rehab games with the FCL Braves this week, and will have his assignment transferred up to Gwinnett beginning Friday. Kim struggled mightily at the plate for the Braves before being placed back on the IL at the start of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen (elbow) waiting for other opinions from other doctors
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said that Zac Gallen "is waiting for other opinions from other doctors."
impact: Gallen was placed on the injured list last weekend. There should be an update on his status later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Soroka (glute) without timetable to return
desc: Michael Soroka remains without a clear timetable to return.
impact: Soroka will need to make a rehab start before returning to Arizona. He threw a bullpen on Tuesday as he continues to work back from his glute strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corbin Burnes (elbow/shoulder) restarts throwing program
desc: Corbin Burnes restarted his throwing program.
impact: Burnes was shut down from throwing in early June after suffering a teres major strain. He still remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Martinez (elbow) to face live hitters in coming days
desc: Justin Martinez is scheduled to face live hitters in the coming days.
impact: Martinez had Tommy John surgery last June and remains on track for an August return. He'll likely require a lengthy rehab assignment.
